title: Individual Potato, Mushroom and Leek Gratins
subtitle: with Gruyere
description: Baby potatoes baked in cream with portobello mushrooms, leek, garlic and basil, topped with melted Gruyere and baked until golden.

steps.text: Fill a pot with water and 2 tablespoons salt, add the potatoes and bring to the boil. Lower the heat and cook covered for 10 minutes. Drain and cut the potatoes into quarters.

Mix the potatoes with the sliced mushrooms, thinly sliced leek (pale part), garlic, cream, basil leaves, salt and pepper. Divide among 6-8 individual heatproof dishes (or a 30x20 cm baking dish) and cover with foil.
Bake for 40 minutes. Remove the foil, sprinkle with the Gruyere and bake for another 20 minutes or until the cheese is golden.
